company_profile: commercetools provides an API-first, headless commerce platform that enterprise brands use to build online shopping and product discovery.
title: Senior AI Search Engineer
summary: Senior AI Engineer with 8+ years building search, retrieval and LLM systems in production across Healthcare, Telecom and AIOps, with an MSc in Machine Learning and AI. Works with Apache Solr, Lucene indexing and Elasticsearch, and builds semantic and hybrid retrieval with embeddings, vector databases and fine-tuned cross-encoder re-rankers. Ships REST APIs with FastAPI on Docker and Kubernetes, with automated evaluation to show whether relevance really improved. Alongside this, I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD.

experience_edits.new: Fine-tuned a cross-encoder re-ranker on positive and negative pairs over dense vector retrieval of AARP survey data, improving search relevance and retrieval accuracy.

experience_edits.new: Developed an internal RAG-based Project Discovery Assistant in LangGraph, combining semantic retrieval with LLM query understanding and reasoning, reaching a 90% match rate against existing organizational solutions.

project.name: Hybrid Product Search Engine
bullets: Built hybrid product search for large e-commerce catalogs, combining keyword retrieval in Elasticsearch with embedding-based vector search and a fine-tuned cross-encoder re-ranker for natural-language queries.
Measured relevance with NDCG and recall on labelled query sets alongside per-query latency, and served it as a multi-tenant REST API with FastAPI on Kubernetes.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Senior AI Search Engineer role on the Discovery team. The part of my work closest to what you need is retrieval: Solr and Lucene indexing, Elasticsearch, and semantic retrieval with cross-encoder re-ranking. What ties it together is helping people, and now agents, find the right thing when they ask in plain language.

commercetools sits underneath the storefronts of demanding commerce brands, and search is changing fast as shoppers type full sentences and AI agents call the API directly. Making hybrid retrieval fast, affordable and measurably better is exactly the work I want. My fiancée lives in Berlin, and we plan to move to London together and settle there long term.

I would bring relevance work. At United Health Group I fine-tuned a cross-encoder on positive and negative pairs to re-rank dense retrieval, and at Optum a reranker on a recommendation system lifted conversion by 2%. At Viavi I built a RAG assistant with semantic retrieval that reached a 90% match rate. Scala would be new, and I would pick it up with the team.

Outside work I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. It taught me that a good answer only counts if the person asking can find it. I would be glad to talk about how I could help the Discovery team.
